c: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
Princípio do Evangelho de Jesus Cristo, Filho de Deus.
As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
Como está escrito nos profetas: “Eis que eu envio meu mensageiro diante de tua face, que preparará teu caminho diante de ti”. Malaquias 3:1
The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
“Voz do que clama no deserto: ‘Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as veredas dele’”. Isaías 40:3
John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
João estava batizando no deserto, e pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para remissão dos pecados.
And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
E toda a província da Judeia e os de Jerusalém saíam até ele; e todos eram batizados por ele no rio Jordão, confessando seus pecados.
And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
E João se vestia de pelos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em redor de sua cintura; e comia gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
E pregava, dizendo: “Após mim vem aquele que é mais forte do que eu. A ele não sou digno de, encurvando-me, desamarrar a correia de suas sandálias.
I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
Em verdade, eu tenho vos batizado com água, mas ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo”.
And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
E aconteceu naqueles dias que Jesus, vindo de Nazaré da Galileia, foi batizado por João no Jordão.
And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
E logo que saiu da água, viu os céus se abrindo, e o Espírito, que como pomba descia sobre ele.
And there came a voice from heaven, saying , Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
E ouviu-se uma voz dos céus: “Tu és meu Filho amado, em quem me agrado”.
And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
E logo o Espírito o impeliu ao deserto.
And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
E esteve ali no deserto quarenta dias, tentado por Satanás. E estava com os animais selvagens, e os anjos o serviam.
Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
E depois que João foi entregue à prisão, Jesus veio para a Galileia, pregando o Evangelho do Reino de Deus,
And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
e dizendo: “O tempo está cumprido, e o reino de Deus está próximo; arrependei-vos, e crede no Evangelho”.
Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
E, andando junto ao mar da Galileia, viu Simão, e André, seu irmão, que lançavam a rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores;
And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
E Jesus lhes disse: “Vinde após mim, e farei serdes pescadores de gente”.
And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
E eles, deixando imediatamente as suas redes, o seguiram.
And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
E passando dali um pouco mais adiante, viu Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e João, seu irmão, que estavam no barco, consertando as redes.
And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
E logo os chamou. E eles, deixando seu pai Zebedeu no barco com os empregados, foram após ele.
And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
E entraram em Cafarnaum; e, logo no sábado, Jesus, entrando na sinagoga, ensinava.
And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
E admiravam-se de seu ensino, pois os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os escribas.
And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
E havia na sinagoga deles um homem com um espírito imundo, e exclamou,
Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
dizendo: “Ah, que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste para nos destruir? Bem sei quem és: o Santo de Deus”.
And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
E Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: “Cala-te, e sai dele”.
And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
E o espírito imundo, causando-lhe convulsão, e gritando com grande voz, saiu dele.

And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
E se admiraram, a ponto de perguntarem entre si: “Que é isto? Que novo ensino é este? Com autoridade ele ordena até aos espíritos imundos, e eles lhe obedecem!”
And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
E logo sua fama correu por toda a região da Galileia.
And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
E logo, saindo da sinagoga, foram à casa de Simão e de André, com Tiago e João.
But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
E a sogra de Simão estava deitada com febre; e logo lhe disseram dela.
And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
Então, aproximando-se dela, tomou-a pela mão, e a levantou; e imediatamente a febre a deixou, e ela começou a servi-los.
And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
E, chegado o entardecer, quando o sol já se punha, trouxeram-lhe todos os que estavam doentes e os endemoninhados;
And all the city was gathered together at the door.
e toda a cidade se ajuntou à porta.
And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
E curou muitos que estavam doentes de diversas enfermidades, e expulsou muitos demônios; e não deixava os demônios falarem, porque o conheciam.
And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
E levantando-se de madrugada, estando ainda escuro, saiu, foi a um lugar deserto, e ali orava.
And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
E Simão e os que estavam com ele o seguiram.
And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
E, achando-o, disseram-lhe: “Todos te buscam”.
And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
E ele lhes disse: “Vamos para as aldeias vizinhas, para que eu também pregue ali, pois para isso eu vim”.
And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
E ele pregava em suas sinagogas por toda a Galileia, e expulsava os demônios.
And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
E um leproso aproximou-se dele, rogando-lhe, pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, e dizendo-lhe: “Se queres, podes limpar-me”.
And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
E Jesus , movido de compaixão, estendeu a mão, tocou-o, e disse-lhe: “Quero; sê limpo.
And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
E, quando disse isso, logo a lepra saiu dele, e ficou limpo.
And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
EJesus, advertindo-o, logo o despediu,
And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
dizendo-lhe: “Vê, não digas nada a ninguém. Mas vai, mostra-te ao sacerdote, e ofereça por tua purificação o que Moisés mandou, para lhes servir de testemunho”.

But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

Porém, havendo ele saído, começou a anunciar muitas coisas, e a divulgar o acontecido, de maneira que Jesus já não podia entrar publicamente na cidade; mas ficava fora em lugares desertos, e vinham de todas as partes até ele.
And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
E, alguns dias depois, entrou outra vez em Cafarnaum, e ouviu-se que estava em casa.
And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
E logoajuntaram-se tantos, que nem mesmo junto à porta cabiam; e ele lhes anunciava a palavra.
And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
Então vieram a ele uns que traziam um paralítico carregado por quatro.
And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
E, não podendo aproximar-se dele por causa da multidão, descobriram o telhado onde estava e, fazendo um buraco, e baixaram o leito em que jazia o paralítico.
When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
E Jesus, vendo a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: “Filho, teus pecados estão perdoados”.
But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
E estavam ali sentados alguns escribas, que pensavam em seus corações:
Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
“Por que este fala tais blasfêmias? Quem pode perdoar pecados, senão só Deus?”
And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
E Jesus, conhecendo imediatamente em seu espírito que assim pensavam entre si, disse-lhe: “Por que pensais essas coisas em vossos corações?
Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
O que é mais fácil? Dizer ao paralítico: ‘Teus pecados estão perdoados’, ou dizer, ‘Levanta-te, toma teu leito, e anda’?
But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
Mas para que vós saibais que o Filho do homem tem poder na terra para perdoar pecados’, disse ao paralítico:
I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
‘A ti eu digo: levanta-te, toma teu leito, e vai para tua casa’”.
And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
E imediatamente ele se levantou e, tomando o leito, saiu na presença de todos, de maneira que todos se admiraram e glorificaram a Deus, dizendo: “Nunca vimos algo assim”.
And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
E Jesus voltou a sair para o mar; toda a multidão vinha até ele, e ele os ensinava.
And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
E ele, passando, viu Levi, filho de Alfeu, sentado na coletoria de impostos, e disse-lhe: “Segue-me”. E Levi, levantando-se, o seguiu.
And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
E aconteceu que, estando sentado à mesa na casa dele, também muitos publicanos e pecadores estavam sentados à mesa com Jesus e seus discípulos; porque eram muitos, e o haviam seguido.
And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
E os escribas e os fariseus, vendo-o comer com os publicanos e pecadores, disseram a seus discípulos: “Por que ele come e bebe com os publicanos e os pecadores?”
When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
E Jesus, tendo ouvido isso, disse-lhes: “Os que têm saúde não precisam de médico, mas sim, os que estão doentes. Eu não vim chamar os justos, mas sim, os pecadores, ao arrependimento.
And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
E os discípulos de João e os dos fariseus jejuavam; e foram e disseram-lhe: “Por que os discípulos de João e os dos fariseus jejuam, e os teus discípulos não jejuam?”
And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
E Jesus lhes dissem: “Podem os convidados do casamento jejuar enquanto o noivo estiver com eles? Enquanto têm o noivo consigo, não podem jejuar.
But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
Mas dias virão, quando o noivo lhes for tirado; e então naqueles dias jejuarão.
No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
Ninguém põe remendo de pano novo em roupa velha; senão o remendo novo rompe o velho, e se faz pior rasgo.
And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
E ninguém põe vinho novo em odres velhos; senão o vinho novo rompe os odres, derrama-se o vinho, e os odres se danificam; mas o vinho novo deve ser posto em odres novos.
And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
E aconteceu que ele, passando pelas plantações no sábado, seus discípulos, caminhando, começaram a colher espigas.
And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
E os fariseus lhe disseram: “Vê! Por que estão fazendo o que não é lícito no sábado?”
And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
E ele lhes disse: “Vós nunca lestes o que Davi fez, quando teve necessidade e fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?
How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

Como ele entrou na Casa de Deus, quando Abiatar era sumo sacerdote, e comeu os pães da presença Levítico 24:5-9; Êxodo 25:30 (dos quais não é lícito comer, senão aos sacerdotes), e também deu aos que com ele estavam?”
And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
E disse-lhes: “O sábado foi feito por causa do ser humano, não o ser humano por causa do sábado.
Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
Por isso o Filho do homem é Senhor até do sábado”.
And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
E ele entrou outra vez na sinagoga; e estava ali um homem que tinha uma mão atrofiada.
And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
E estavam observandoJesus se o curaria no sábado, para o acusarem.
And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
E ele disse ao homem que tinha a mão atrofiada: “Levanta-te e vem para o meio”.
And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
E disse-lhes: “É lícito no sábado fazer o bem, ou fazer o mal? Salvar uma pessoa, ou matá-la?” E ficaram calados.

And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
E olhando ao redor para eles com indignação, entristecido da dureza do coração deles, disse ao homem: “Estende atua mão”. E ele a estendeu; e sua mão foi restaurada, sã como a outra.
And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
E havendo os fariseus saído, logo formaram conselho com os herodianos contra ele, sobre como o matariam.
But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,
E Jesus retirou-se com os seus discípulos para o mar; e o seguiu uma grande multidão da Galileia, da Judeia,
And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
de Jerusalém, da Idumeia, dalém do Jordão; e das proximidades de Tiro e de Sidom uma grande multidão, tendo ouvido quão grandes coisas fazia, vieram a ele.
And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
E disse a seus discípulos que um barquinho permanecesse pronto para ele, por causa das multidões; para que não o apertassem.
For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
Pois havia curado muitos, de maneira que todos quantos tinham alguma doença lançavam-se sobre ele, para tocá-lo.
And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
E os espíritos imundos, vendo-o, prostravam-se diante dele, e exclamavam: “Tu és o Filho de Deus”.
And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
E ele os repreendia muito, para que não manifestassem quem ele era.
And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
E ele subiu ao monte, e chamou para si os que quis; e vieram a ele.
And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
E constituiu os doze, para que estivessem com ele, e para enviá-los a pregar,
And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
e para que tivessem poder de curar as enfermidades e expulsar os demônios:
And Simon he surnamed Peter;
Simão, a quem pôs por nome Pedro;
And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
Tiago filho de Zebedeu, e João, irmão de Tiago; e pôs-lhes por nome Boanerges, que significa “filhos do trovão”;
And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
e André, Filipe, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tomé; Tiago filho de Alfeu; Tadeu; Simão, o zelote;
And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
e Judas Iscariotes, o que o traiu.
And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
E foram para casa. E outra vez se ajuntou a multidão, de maneira que nem sequer podiam comer pão.
And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
E quando os seus familiares, ouviram isso, saíram para detê-lo, porque diziam: “Ele está fora de si”.
And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
E os escribas que haviam descido de Jerusalém diziam: “Ele tem Belzebu, e é pelo príncipe dos demônios que expulsa demônios”.
And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
E ele, chamando-os para si, disse-lhes por parábolas: “Como pode Satanás expulsar Satanás?
And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
E, se um reino estiver dividido contra si mesmo, tal reino não pode perdurar;
And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
e, se alguma casa estiver dividida contra si mesma, tal casa não pode perdurar.
And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
E se Satanás se levantar contra si mesmo, e estiver dividido, não pode perdurar, mas tem fim.
No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
Ninguém pode roubar os bens de um homem forte, entrando na casa dele, se primeiro não amarrar o homem forte; e então roubará sua casa.
Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
Em verdade vos digo que todos os pecados serão perdoados aos filhos dos homens, e todas as blasfêmias com que blasfemarem;
But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
porém quem blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo não obterá perdão para sempre; mas será culpado do juízo eterno”.
Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
Pois diziam: “Ele tem espírito imundo”.
There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
Então chegaram seus irmãos e sua mãe; e, estando de fora, mandaram chamá-lo.
And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
E a multidão estava sentada ao redor dele. E disseram-lhe: “Eis que tua mãe e teus irmãos te procuram lá fora.
And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
E ele lhes respondeu: “Quem é minha mãe ou meus irmãos?”
And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
E, olhando em redor para os que estavam sentados junto dele, disse: “Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos.
For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
Pois quem fizer a vontade de Deus, esse é meu irmão, minha irmã, e mãe”.
And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
E outra vez ele começou a ensinar junto ao mar, e uma grande multidão ajuntou-se a ele, de maneira que ele, entrando num barco no mar, assentou-se; e toda a multidão estava em terra junto ao mar.
And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
E ensinava-lhes muitas coisas por parábolas; e dizia-lhes em seu ensino:
Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
“Ouçam: eis que o semeador saiu a semear;
And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
E aconteceu que ele, semeando, uma parte da semente caiu junto ao caminho, e vieram as aves do céu, e a comeram.
And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
E outra caiu em pedregulhos, onde não havia muita terra; e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra profunda.
But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
Mas, saindo o sol, queimou-se; e porque não tinha raiz, secou-se.
And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
E outra caiu entre espinhos; e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram, e não deu fruto.
And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
E outra caiu em boa terra, e deu fruto, que subiu, e cresceu; e um deu trinta, outro sessenta, e outro cem”.
And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
E disse-lhes: “Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça”.
And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
E quando esteve só, os que estavam junto dele, com os doze, perguntaram-lhe acerca da parábola.
And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
E respondeu-lhes: “A vós é concedido saber o mistério do reino de Deus; mas aos de fora, todas estas coisas se dizem por de parábolas;
That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
para que vendo, vejam, e não percebam; e ouvindo, ouçam, e não entendam; para não haver que se convertam, e sejam-lhes perdoados os pecados”. Isaías 6:9-10
And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
E disse-lhes: “Vós não sabeis o significado desta parábola? Como, pois, entendereis todas as parábolas?
The sower soweth the word.
O semeador semeia a palavra.
And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
E os que estão junto ao caminho são aqueles em quem a palavra é semeada; mas, havendo-a ouvido, logo Satanás vem e tira a palavra que foi semeada nos seus corações.
And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
E, semelhantemente, os que recebem a semente em pedregulhos, são aqueles que, tendo ouvido a palavra, logo a recebem com alegria.
And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
Mas não têm raiz em si mesmos; em vez disso, são temporários. Depois, levantando-se a tribulação ou a perseguição por causa da palavra, logo acham motivo de tropeço.
And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
E os que recebem a semente entre espinhos são os que ouvem a palavra,
And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
mas as preocupações deste mundo, a sedução das riquezas, e as cobiças de outras coisas, entrando, sufocam a palavra, e ela fica sem fruto.
And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it , and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
E os que foram semeados em boa terra são os que ouvem a palavra e a recebem, e dão fruto, um trinta, outro sessenta, e outro cem.
And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
E disse-lhes: “Acaso a lâmpada vem para se pôr debaixo de uma caixa, ou debaixo da cama? Ela não deve ser posta na luminária?”
For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
Porque não há nada encoberto que não haja de ser manifesto; e nada se faz para ficar encoberto, mas sim, para vir à luz.
If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça”.
And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
E disse-lhes: “Cuidado com o que ouvis. Com a medida que vós medirdes, será medido para vós, e será acrescentado a vós que ouvis.
For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
Pois ao que tem, será dado; e ao que não tem, até o que tem lhe será tirado”.
And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
E dizia: “O Reino de Deus é assim, como se um homem lançasse semente à terra;
And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
e dormisse, e se levantasse, de noite e de dia, e a semente brotasse e crescesse, não sabendo ele como.
For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
Pois a terra de si mesma frutifica, primeiro a erva, depois a espiga, depois o grão cheio na espiga.
But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
E quando o fruto está pronto, logo mete-lhe a foice, pois a colheita chegou”.
And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
E ele dizia: “A que assemelharemos o Reino de Deus? Ou com que parábola o compararemos?
It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
É como um grão da mostarda que, quando semeado na terra, é a menor de todas as sementes que há na terra.
But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
Mas, depois de semeado, cresce, e se torna a maior de todas as hortaliças, e cria grandes ramos, de maneira que as aves do céu podem aninhar-se debaixo de sua sombra”.
And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it .
E com muitas parábolas desse tipo ele lhes falava a palavra, conforme o que podiam ouvir.
But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
E não lhes falava sem parábola; mas aos seus discípulos explicava tudo em particular.
And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
E naquele dia, vindo o entardecer, disse-lhes: “Passemos para o outro lado”.
And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
E eles, deixando a multidão, o levaram consigo como estava, no barco; mas havia também com ele outros barquinhos.
And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
E levantou-se uma grande tempestade de vento; as ondas subiam por cima do barco, de maneira que já se enchia.
And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
E ele estava na popa dormindo sobre uma almofada; e o despertaram, e disseram-lhe: “Mestre, não te importas que pereçamos?”
And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
E ele, despertando, repreendeu o vento, e disse ao mar: “Cala-te, aquieta-te!” E o vento se aquietou, e houve grande bonança.
And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
E perguntou-lhes: “Por que vós tendes tanto medo? Como não tendes fé?”
And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
E sentiram grande temor, e diziam uns aos outros: “Mas quem é este, que até o vento e o mar lhe obedecem?”
And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
E chegaram ao outro lado do mar, à terra dos Gadarenos.
And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
E ele, saindo do barco, logo lhe saiu ao encontro, vindo dos sepulcros, um homem com um espírito imundo,
Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
que morava nas sepulturas, e nem mesmo com correntes conseguiam prendê-lo;
Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
pois muitas vezes havia sido preso com grilhões e correntes; mas as correntes eram por ele despedaçadas, os grilhões eram esmigalhados, e ninguém conseguia dominá-lo.
And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
E andava sempre, de dia e de noite, gritando pelos montes e pelas sepulturas, e ferindo-se com pedras.
But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
E, quando viu Jesus de longe, correu e prostrou-se diante dele.
And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
E exclamando em alta voz, disse: “Que tenho eu contigo Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Rogo-te por Deus que não me atormentes”.
For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
(Porque Jesus lhe dizia: “Sai desse homem, espírito imundo”.)
And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
E perguntou-lhe: “Qual é o teu nome?” E respondeu: “Meu nome é Legião, porque somos muitos”.
And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
E rogava-lhe muito que não os expulsasse daquele território.
Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
E estava ali junto aos montes uma grande manada de porcos pastando.
And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
E todos aqueles demônios rogaram-lhe, dizendo: “Manda-nos para aqueles porcos, para que entremos neles”.

And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
E logo Jesus lhes permitiu. E aqueles espíritos imundos, saindo, entraram nos porcos; e a manada lançou-se abaixo no mar; (eram quase dois mil) e afogaram-se no mar.
And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
Os que apascentavam os porcos fugiram, e anunciaram na cidade e nos campos; e as pessoas saíram para ver o que havia acontecido.
And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
E foram até Jesus, e viram o endemoninhado, o que tivera a legião, sentado, vestido, e em são juízo; e temeram.
And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
E os que tinham visto contaram-lhes o que acontecera ao endemoninhado, e acerca dos porcos.
And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
E começaram a rogar-lhe que Jesus saísse do território deles.
And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
E quando ele entrava no barco, o que estivera endemoninhado rogou-lhe que estivesse com ele.
Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
Porém Jesus não lhe permitiu, mas lhe disse: “Vai para tua casa, aos teus, e anuncia-lhes quão grandes coisas o Senhor fez contigo, e como teve misericórdia de ti”.
And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
E foi embora, e começou a anunciar em Decápolis quão grandes coisas Jesus havia feito com ele; e todos se admiravam.
And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
E Jesus, havendo passado outra vez num barco para o outro lado, uma grande multidão se ajuntou a ele; e ele estava junto ao mar.
And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
E eis que chegou um dos chefes da sinagoga, por nome Jairo; e, vendo-o, prostrou-se a seus pés.
And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
E rogava-lhe muito, dizendo: “Minha filhinha está perto de morrer; rogo-te que venhas e ponhas as mãos sobre ela, para que se cure, e viva”.
And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
E Jesus foi com ele; e uma grande multidão o seguia e o apertava.
And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
E uma certa mulher, que tinha um fluxo de sangue havia doze anos,
And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
e que havia sofrido muito com muitos médicos, e gastado tudo quanto tinha, e nada havia lhe aproveitado; ao invés disso, piorava,
When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
ela, ouvindo falar de Jesus, veio entre a multidão por detrás, e tocou a roupa dele.
For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
Porque dizia: “Se tão somente tocar suas roupas, serei curada”.
And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
E imediatamente secou-se a fonte de seu sangue; e sentiu no corpo estar curada daquele flagelo.
And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
E imediatamente Jesus, conhecendo que o poder havia saído dele, virando-se na multidão, disse: “Quem tocou minhas roupas?”
And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
E seus discípulos lhe disseram: “Vês que a multidão te aperta, e dizes: ‘Quem me tocou?’”
And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
E ele olhava em redor, para ver quem havia lhe feito isso.
But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
Então a mulher, temendo e tremendo, sabendo o que lhe havia sido feito, aproximou-se, prostrou-se diante dele, e disse-lhe toda a verdade.
And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
E ele lhe disse: “Filha, tua fé te salvou. Vai em paz, e fica curada deste teu flagelo”.
While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
Estando ele ainda falando, alguns vieram da parte do chefe da sinagoga, e disseram: “Tua filha está morta; por que ainda estás incomodando o Mestre?”
As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
Mas Jesus, ouvindo essa palavra que se dizia, disse ao chefe da sinagoga: “Não temas; crê somente”.
And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
E não permitiu que ninguém o seguisse, senão Pedro, Tiago, e João, irmão de Tiago.
And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
E eles, havendo chegado à casa do chefe da sinagoga, ele viu o alvoroço, e os que choravam muito e pranteavam.
And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
E ele, entrando, disse-lhes: “Por que vós estais fazendo alvoroço e chorando? A menina não está morta, mas dorme”.
And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
E riram dele. Mas Jesus, havendo-os posto todos fora, tomou consigo o pai e a mãe da menina, e os que estavam com ele; e entrou onde a menina estava deitada.
And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
E, pegando a mão da menina, disse-lhe: “Talita cumi”, que significa: “Menina, eu te digo, levanta-te”.
And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
E imediatamente a menina se levantou e andava, pois já tinha doze anos. E tiveram grande espanto.
And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
E mandou-lhes severamente que ninguém soubesse disso; e disse que dessem a ela de comer.
And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
E partiu dali, e chegou à sua terra, e seus discípulos o seguiram.

And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

E chegando o sábado, começou a ensinar na sinagoga; e muitos, ouvindo-o, espantavam-se, dizendo: “De onde lhe vem estas coisas? E que sabedoria é esta que lhe foi dada? E tais maravilhas que se fazem por suas mãos?
Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
Não é este o carpinteiro, filho de Maria, e irmão de Tiago, de José, de Judas, e de Simão? E não estão aqui as suas irmãs conosco? E escandalizaram-se nele”.
But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
E Jesus lhes dizia: “Não há profeta que não tenha honra, senão em sua terra, entre os parentes, e em sua casa”.
And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them .
E ele não pôde ali fazer milagre algum, senão somente curou uns poucos enfermos, sobre os quais pôs as mãos.
And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
E estava admirado da incredulidade deles. E percorreu as aldeias vizinhas, ensinando.
And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
E chamou a si os doze, e começou a enviá-los de dois em dois; e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos.
And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
E mandou-lhes que não levassem nada para o caminho, senão somente um cajado; nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro no cinto;
But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
mas que calçassem sandálias, e não se vestissem de duas túnicas.
And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
E dizia-lhes: “Onde quer que vós entrardes em alguma casa, ficai nela até que saiais dali.

And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

E todos os que não vos receberem, nem vos ouvirem, quando sairdes dali, sacudam o pó que estiver debaixo de vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles Em verdade vos digo, que mais tolerável será para Sodoma ou Gomorra no dia do juízo, do que para aquela cidade.
And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
E eles, saindo, pregaram que se arrependessem.
And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them .
E expulsavam muitos demônios, e ungiam muitos enfermos com azeite, e os curavam.
And king Herod heard of him ; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
E o rei Herodes ouviu falar disso, porque o nome de Jesus já era notório; e dizia: “João Batista foi ressuscitado dos mortos, e por isso essas maravilhas operam nele”.
Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
Outros diziam: “É Elias”; e outros diziam: “É profeta, ou como algum dos profetas”.
But when Herod heard thereof , he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
Porém Herodes, ouviu falar disso, disse: “Esse é João, de quem mandei cortar a cabeça. Ele ressuscitou dos mortos”.
For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
Pois o mesmo Herodes havia mandado prender João, e acorrentá-lo na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher de Filipe, seu irmão, porque havia se casado com ela.
For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
Porque João dizia a Herodes: “Não te é lícito possuir a mulher de teu irmão”.
Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
E Herodias o odiava, e queria matá-lo, mas não podia,
For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
porque Herodes temia João, sabendo que era um homem justo e santo, e o protegia. E quando o ouvia, fazia muitas coisas, e o ouvia de boa vontade.
And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
E, chegando um dia oportuno, em que Herodes, no dia do seu aniversário, dava uma ceia aos grandes de sua corte, aos comandantes militares, e aos principais da Galileia;
And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
e, havendo a filha dessa Herodias entrado dançando, agradou a Herodes e aos que estavam sentados à mesa com ele. O rei disse à jovem: “Pede-me quanto quiseres, que eu te darei”.
And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
E jurou a ela, dizendo: “Tudo o que me pedires eu te darei, até a metade de meu reino”.
And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
E ela, saindo, disse à sua mãe: “Que pedirei?” E ela disse: “A cabeça de João Batista”.
And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
E imediatamente ela, entrando apressadamente ao rei, pediu, dizendo: “Quero que agora mesmo me dês num prato a cabeça de João Batista”.
And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
E o rei entristeceu-se muito; mas, por causa dos juramentos, e dos que estavam juntamente à mesa, não quis negar a ela.
And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
E o rei, enviando imediatamente o executor, mandou trazer ali sua cabeça. E ele foi e o decapitou na prisão.
And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
E trouxe sua cabeça num prato, e o deu à jovem; e a jovem a deu à sua mãe.
And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
E os discípulos dele, ouvindo isso, vieram, pegaram seu cadáver, e o puseram num sepulcro.
And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
Os apóstolos ajuntaram-se de volta a Jesus, e contaram-lhe tudo, tanto o que haviam feito, como o que haviam ensinado.
And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
E ele lhes disse: “Vinde aqui à parte a um lugar deserto, e repousai um pouco”; porque havia muitos que iam e vinham, e não tinham tempo para comer.
And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
E foram num barco a um lugar deserto, à parte.
And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
Mas as multidões os viram partir, e muitos o reconheceram. E correram para lá a pé de todas as cidades, e chegaram antes deles, e aproximaram-se dele.
And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
E Jesus saindo do barco, viu uma grande multidão, e teve compaixão deles, porque eram como ovelhas que não têm pastor. E começou a ensinar-lhes muitas coisas.
And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
E quando já era tarde do dia, seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: “O lugar é deserto, e já é tarde do dia.
Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
Despede-os, para que vão aos campos e aldeias vizinhas, e comprem pão para si; pois não têm o que comer”.
He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
Porém ele, respondendo, disse: “Dai-lhes vós mesmos de comer”. E eles lhe disseram: “Acaso iremos, e compraremos duzentos denários de pão, e lhes daremos de comer?”
He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
E ele lhes disse: “Quantos pães tendes? Ide ver”. E eles, quando souberam, disseram: “Cinco, e dois peixes”.
And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
E mandou-lhes que fizessem assentar a todos em grupos sobre a relva verde.
And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
E assentaram-se repartidos de cem em cem, e de cinquenta em cinquenta.

And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

E ele, tomando os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, abençoou, e partiu os pães, e os deu aos seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E os dois peixes repartiu entre todos.
And they did all eat, and were filled.
E todos comeram e se saciaram.
And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
E levantaram dos pedaços de pão e dos peixes doze cestos cheios.
And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
Os que comeram os pães eram quase cinco mil homens.
And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
E logo mandou seus discípulos subirem no barco, e ir adiante para o outro lado, para Betsaida, enquanto ele despedia a multidão.
And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
E, havendo-os despedido, foi ao monte para orar.
And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
E vindo o entardecer, o barco estava no meio do mar, e Jesus sozinho em terra.
And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
E viu que se cansavam muito remando, porque o vento lhes era contrário; e perto da quarta vigília da noite, aproximou-se deles andando sobre o mar, e queria passar adiante deles.
But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
Mas eles, vendo-o andar sobre o mar, pensaram que era uma fantasma, e deram grandes gritos,
For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
porque todos o viam, e perturbaram-se. Mas logo falou com eles, e disse-lhes: “Tende coragem! Sou eu, não temais”.
And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
E subiu no barco para estar com eles, e o vento se aquietou; e entre si ficaram muito espantados e maravilhados,
For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
pois não haviam entendido o que acontecera com os pães, porque o coração deles estava endurecido.
And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
E quando fizeram a travessia, chegaram à terra de Genesaré, e ali aportaram.
And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
E eles, saindo do barco, logo as pessoas o reconheceram.
And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
E corriam por toda aquela região, e começaram a trazer em leitos os doentes, aonde quer que ouviam falar que ele estava.

And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
E aonde quer que ele entrava, em povoados, ou cidades, ou aldeias, colocavam os enfermos nas praças, e rogavam-lhe que ao menos tocassem a borda de sua veste; e todos os que o tocavam eram curados.
Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
E reuniram-se perto dele os fariseus, e alguns dos escribas, que tinham vindo de Jerusalém.
And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
E vendo que alguns dos discípulos dele comiam pão com mãos impuras, isto é, sem lavar, os repreendiam;
For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
(porque os fariseus, e todos os judeus, conservando a tradição dos antigos, não comem sem lavarem as mãos muitas vezes.
And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
E, voltando da praça, se não se lavarem, não comem. E há muitas outras coisas que se encarregam de guardar, como lavar os copos, os jarros, os vasos de metal, e os leitos).
Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
Depois os fariseus e os escribas lhe perguntaram: “Por que teus discípulos não andam conforme a tradição dos antigos, mas comem pão com as mãos sem lavar?”
He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
Porém ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: “Isaías bem profetizou acerca de vós, hipócritas! Como está escrito: ‘Este povo me honra com os lábios, mas seu coração está longe de mim.
Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
Porém eles me honram em vão, ensinando como doutrinas os mandamentos humanos’. Isaías 29:13
For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
Pois vós, deixando o mandamento de Deus, vos apegais à tradição humana, como lavar os jarros e os copos; e fazeis muitas outras coisas semelhantes a essas”.
And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
E dizia-lhes: “Vós rejeitais o mandamento de Deus para guardardes vossa tradição;
For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
porque Moisés disse: ‘Honra teu pai e tua mãe’. Êxodo 20:12, Deuteronômio 5:16 E ‘quem maldisser ao pai ou à mãe deverá morrer’. Êxodo 21:17, Levítico 20:9
But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free .
Mas vós dizeis: ‘Se o homem disser ao pai ou à mãe: Tudo o que te puder aproveitar de mim é corbã (isto é, uma oferta),
And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
então vós não lhe permitis mais fazer coisa alguma por seu pai ou por sua mãe.
Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
Assim, invalidais a palavra de Deus por vossa tradição, que vós ordenastes; e fazeis muitas coisas semelhantes a essas”.
And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand:
E chamando a si toda a multidão, disse-lhes: “Ouvi-me vós todos, e entendei:
There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
Não há nada fora do ser humano, nele entrando, que o possa contaminar; mas o que dele sai, isso é o que contamina o ser humano.
If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
E, quando deixou a multidão e entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram sobre a parábola.
And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
E ele lhes disse: “Então também vós não tendes entendimento? Não compreendeis que tudo o que entra de fora no ser humano não o pode contaminar?
Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
Porque não entra em seu coração, mas sim, no estômago, e sai para a privada”. (Assim, ele declarou puros todos os alimentos).
And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
E dizia: “O que sai do ser humano, isso contamina o ser humano.
For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
Pois de dentro do coração dos seres humanos saem os maus pensamentos, os adultérios, os pecados sexuais, os homicídios,
Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
os furtos, as ganâncias, as maldades, o engano, a devassidão, a inveja, a blasfêmia, a soberba, a insensatez.
All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
Todos estes males procedem de dentro, e contaminam o ser humano”.
And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid.
E, havendo levantado-se dali, foi para a região de Tiro e de Sidom. E, entrando numa casa, não queria que ninguém soubesse disso, mas não pôde se esconder.
For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
Porque uma mulher, cuja filha tinha um espírito imundo, ouvindo falar dele, foi, e lançou-se a seus pés.
The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
Esta mulher era grega, de nacionalidade sirofenícia; e rogava-lhe que expulsasse o demônio de sua filha.
But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
Mas Jesus lhe disse: “Deixa que primeiro os filhos se saciem; porque não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos, e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos”.
And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
Porém ela respondeu, e disse-lhe: “Sim Senhor; mas também os cachorrinhos comem, debaixo da mesa, as migalhas dos filhos”.
And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
Então ele lhe disse: “Por causa dessa palavra, vai; o demônio já saiu de tua filha”.
And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
E ela, indo para sua casa, achou a filha deitada sobre a cama, e o demônio já havia saído.
And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
E Jesus, voltando a sair da região de Tiro e de Sidom, e foi para o mar da Galilea, por meio da região de Decápolis.
And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
E trouxeram-lhe um surdo que falava com dificuldade, e rogaram-lhe que pusesse a mão sobre ele.
And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
E, levando-o em separado da multidão, pôs-lhe os dedos nos ouvidos; e, cuspindo, tocou-lhe a língua.
And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
E, levantando os olhos ao céu, suspirou, e disse: “Efatá”, (isto é, abre-te).
And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
E imediatamente os ouvidos dele se abriram, e sua língua se soltou, e começou a falar perfeitamente.
And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it ;
E Jesus ordenou-lhes que a ninguém dissessem; mas, quanto mais lhes ordenava, mais o divulgavam.
And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
E, grandemente admirados, diziam: “Tudo ele faz bem! Aos surdos faz ouvir, e aos mudos falar”.
In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them,
Naqueles dias, havendo uma muito grande multidão, e não tinham o que comer, Jesus chamou os seus discípulos a si, e disse-lhes:
I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
“Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque já há três dias que estão comigo, e não têm o que comer.
And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
E se eu os deixar ir em jejum para suas casas, desmaiarão no caminho; porque alguns deles vieram de longe”.
And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
E seus discípulos lhe responderam: “De onde alguém poderá saciar estes de pão aqui no deserto?”
And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
E perguntou-lhes: “Quantos pães tendes?” E eles disseram: “Sete”.

And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them ; and they did set them before the people.

Então mandou à multidão que se assentassem no chão. E, tomando os sete pães, e havendo dado graças, partiu-os, e os deu a seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles; e eles os puseram diante da multidão.
And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them .
Tinham também uns poucos peixinhos; e, havendo dado graças, disse que também os pusessem diante deles.
So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
E eles comeram, e se saciaram; e dos pedaços que sobraram, recolheram sete cestos.
And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
E os que comeram eram quase quatro mil. Então os despediu.
And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
E logo entrando no barco com seus discípulos, foi para a região de Dalmanuta.
And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
Os fariseus chegaram, e começaram a disputar com ele, pedindo-lhe um sinal do céu, para o testarem.
And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
E ele, suspirando profundamente em seu espírito, disse: “Por que esta geração pede um sinal? Em verdade vos digo que não se dará sinal a esta geração”.
And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
E, deixando-os, voltou a entrar no barco, e foi para a outro lado.
Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
E seus discípulos haviam se esquecido de pegar pão, e nada tinham, senão um pão consigo no barco.
And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
E ele ordenou-lhes, dizendo: “Atenção! Tende cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e o fermento de Herodes”.
And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
E argumentavam entre si, dizendo: “É porque não temos pão”.
And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
EJesus, conhecendo isso, disse-lhes: “Por que vós argumentais que não tendes pão? Não percebeis ainda, nem entendeis? Vós ainda tendes vosso coração endurecido?
Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
Vós, tendo olhos, não vedes? E tendo ouvidos, não ouvis? E não vos lembrais?
When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
Quando parti os cinco pães entre os cinco mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços vós recolhestes?” Disseram-lhe: “Doze”.
And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
“E quando parti os sete entre os quatro mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços vós recolhestes?” Eles disseram: “Sete”.
And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
E ele lhes disse: “Como vós não entendeis?”
And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
E chegou a Betsaida. E trouxeram-lhe um cego, e rogaram-lhe que o tocasse.
And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
E ele, tomando o cego pela mão, levou-o para fora da aldeia. E, cuspindo-lhe nos olhos, e pondo as mãos sobre dele, perguntou-lhe se via alguma coisa.
And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
E ele, levantando os olhos, disse: “Vejo as pessoas; pois vejo como árvores andando”.
After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
Então Jesus voltou a pôr as mãos sobre os olhos dele, e os fez levantar. E ficou restabelecido, e via a todos claramente.
And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
E o mandou para sua casa, dizendo: “Não entres na aldeia, nem contes a ninguém da aldeia”.
And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
E Jesus saiu com seus discípulos para as aldeias de Cesareia de Filipe; e no caminho perguntou a seus discípulos, dizendo-lhes: “Quem as pessoas dizem que eu sou?”
And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say , Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
E eles responderam: “João Batista, e outros, Elias; e outros, algum dos profetas”.
And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
E ele lhes disse: “Porém quem vos dizeis que eu sou?” E Pedro, respondendo, disse-lhe: “Tu és o Cristo”.
And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
E mandou-lhes severamente que a ninguém dissessem aquilo dele.
And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

E começou a ensinar-lhes que era necessário que o Filho do homem sofresse muito, e fosse rejeitado pelos anciãos, pelos chefes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas, e que fosse morto, e depois de três dias ressuscitasse.
And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
E dizia abertamente essa palavra. E Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo.
But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
Mas ele, virando-se, e olhando para seus discípulos, repreendeu a Pedro, dizendo: “Retira-te de diante de mim, Satanás! Porque tu não compreendes as coisas de Deus, mas sim, as humanas”.
And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
E, chamando a si a multidão, com os seus discípulos, disse-lhes: “Quem quiser vir após mim, negue a si mesmo, tome sua cruz, e siga-me;
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
pois quem quiser salvar sua vida, irá perdê-la; mas quem perder sua vida por causa de mim e do Evangelho, esse a salvará.
For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
Pois que aproveitaria ao ser humano, se ganhasse o mundo todo, e perdesse sua alma?
Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
Ou que o ser humano daria em resgate de sua alma?

Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
Porque quem se envergonhar de mim e de minhas palavras nesta geração adúltera e pecadora, também o Filho do homem se envergonhará dele, quando vier na glória de seu Pai com os santos anjos”.
And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
E dizia-lhes também: “Em verdade vos digo, que há alguns dos que aqui estão, que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o reino de Deus vindo com poder”.
And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
E seis dias depois, Jesus tomou consigo Pedro, Tiago, e João, e os levou à parte, em particular, para um alto monte; e transfigurou-se diante deles.
And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
E as roupas dele ficaram resplandescentes, muito brancas como a neve, como nenhum lavadeiro na terra as poderia branquear.
And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
E apareceram-lhes Elias com Moisés, e falavam com Jesus.
And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: “Mestre, é bom para nós que estejamos aqui; e façamos três tendas: uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias”.
For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
Pois não sabia o que dizia, porque estavam assombrados.
And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
E desceu uma nuvem, que os cobriu com sua sombra, e veio uma voz da nuvem, que dizia: “Este é meu Filho amado; ouçam a ele”.
And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
E imediatamente eles, olhando em redor, não viram mais ninguém, senão só Jesus com eles.
And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
E eles, descendo do monte, Jesus lhes ordenou que a ninguém contassem o que haviam visto, até que o Filho do homem ressuscitasse dos mortos.
And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
E eles retiveram o caso entre si, perguntando uns aos outros que seria aquilo de “ressuscitar dos mortos”.
And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
Então lhe perguntaram: “Por que os escribas dizem que é necessário Elias venha primeiro?”
And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
E ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: “De fato Elias vem primeiro, e restaura todas as coisas. Mas, como está escrito sobre o Filho do homem deverá sofrer muito, e ser desprezado?
But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
Porém eu vos digo que Elias já veio, e fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram, como dele está escrito”.
And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
E quando se aproximou dos discípulos, ele viu uma grande multidão ao redor deles; e uns escribas que discutiam com eles.
And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
E logo toda a multidão, vendo-o, ficou admirada; e, correndo para ele, o cumprimentaram.
And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
E ele perguntou aos escribas: “O que discutis com eles?”
And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
E um da multidão, respondendo, disse: “Mestre, trouxe-te meu filho, que tem um espírito mudo.
And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
E onde quer que toma posse dele, lança-o ao chão, e ele espuma, range os dentes, e vai ficando endurecido. E eu disse a teus discípulos que o expulsassem, mas não conseguiram”.
He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
E ele, respondendo-lhe, disse: “Ó geração incrédula! Até quando estarei convosco? Até quando vos suportarei? Trazei-o a mim”.
And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
E o trouxeram a ele. E quando o viu, logo o espírito o agitou com violência, e caindo em terra, rolava, espumando.
And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
E perguntou a seu pai: “Quanto tempo há que isto lhe acontece?” E ele lhe disse: “Desde a infância.
And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
E muitas vezes o lançou tanto no fogo como na água para o destruir. Mas, se podes fazer algo, tem compaixão de nós, e ajuda-nos”.
Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
E Jesus lhe disse: “Se podes crer, tudo é possível ao que crê”.
And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
Logo o pai do menino, clamando com lágrimas, disse: “Creio, Senhor! Ajuda minha incredulidade”.
When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
E Jesus, vendo que a multidão se aglomerava, repreendeu o espírito imundo, dizendo-lhe: “Espírito mudo e surdo, eu te ordeno, sai dele, e nunca mais entres nele”.
And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
E ele, gritando, e agitando-o com violência, saiu. E o menino ficou como morto, de maneira que muitos diziam que estava morto.
But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
Mas Jesus, tomando-o pela mão, ergueu-o; e ele se levantou.
And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
E quando entrou em casa, seus discípulos lhe perguntaram à parte: “Por que nós não conseguimos expulsá-lo?”
And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
E lhes respondeu: “Este tipo não pode sair por coisa alguma, senão com oração e jejum”.
And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it .
E, havendo eles partido dali, caminharam pela Galileia; e ele não queria que ninguém soubesse,
For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
porque ensinava seus discípulos, e dizia-lhes: “O Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens, e o matarão; e ele, morto, ressuscitará ao terceiro dia”.
But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, e temiam perguntar-lhe.
And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
E chegou a Cafarnaum, e, entrando em casa, perguntou-lhes: “Que vós discutíeis pelo caminho?”
But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
Mas eles ficaram calados; porque pelo caminho haviam discutido entre si qual deles seria o maior.
And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
E ele, assentando-se, chamou aos doze, e disse-lhes: “Se alguém quiser ser o primeiro, será o último de todos e o servo de todos”.
And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
E, tomando uma criança, a pôs no meio deles e, tomando-a entre seus braços, disse-lhes:
